subject: gk
question:
Article 157 of the Constitution of India, states which of the following qualifications to be fulfilled for a person to be appointed Governor of a state?

(i) He / She should be an Indian citizen.

(ii) He / She should have completed 35 years of age.
solution:
The correct answer is __**both (i) and (ii).**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3594069eb4eac3d559af7c626aabe4ee4145967932cf8ad78e35476f134a4b8.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Article 153 of the Indian Constitution deals with the Governor of states which comes under part VI of the constitution.
 
• **The governor** is nothing but a chief executive head of the state.
 
• He is also known as the nominal head of the given state.
 
• Under the 7th Constitutional Amendment Act of 1956, the Governor can be appointed for two or more states.
 
• He is known for being appointed by the President of India by warrant under his hand and seal.
 
• The role of the Governor is an independent constitutional office, and it is not under the control of the union government.
 
• Under Article 157 of the constitution, the Governor can have only two qualifications. They are:
 
 
• He must be a citizen of our country.
 
• He must have completed 35 years of age.
 
 
 
• To appoint a person as a Governor the President has to consult the Chief Minister of the required state.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3e20068b61817b168623bbf4377a66602deb382bfb1e34ae29a5e35078dcefcb.png] Additional Information__

 
• The salary of the Governor is being fixed by the Parliament.
 
• In the year 2018, the salary of the Governor was increased from 1.10 lakh rupees to 3.50 lakh rupees per month by the Parliament.
 
• The term of the governor's office is normally five years but it can be terminated earlier by Dismissal by the president at whose pleasure the governor holds office. Dismissal of governors without valid reason is not permitted. 
 
• He can resign from the office by writing the resignation letter to the President.
 
• He was even removed by the President at any time.
 
• He is assigned with the following powers and functions in the given state. They are:
 
 
• Executive Powers
 
• Legislative Powers
 
• Judicial Powers
 
• Financial Powers
